newsitem.title: GERMANY: PARIBAS RAISES ADIDAS TO BUY FROM NO ACTION.
newsitem.headline: PARIBAS RAISES ADIDAS TO BUY FROM NO ACTION.

text.p: Paribas Capital Markets said on Thursday that it has raised German sportswear group Adidas AG to a buy rating from no action.
Paribas analyst Michael Wand said in a market comment report that Adidas' results released on Wednesday were the reason for the change.
Adidas on Wednesday said first-half operating profit rose 42 percent to 208 million marks behind a 40 percent rise in sales to 3.14 billion marks.
Shares in Adidas were up 4.45 marks, or two percent, at 226.75 marks in pre-bourse trade, compared to the overall IBIS DAX blue-chips' index, which was up 1.06 percent at 4,410.68 points.
Wand noted that Adidas' operating business was doing extremely well with order growth of 43 percent when adjusted for currency movements.
He also said that he would upgrade sales figures to about 30 percent growth for full-year 1997 and revenue growth will be upgraded to around to around 20 percent for 1998 from 15 percent.
